description: neutral means neither positive nor negative. e.g. He sat quietly, showing no particular reaction to the events around him. & The room was filled with a quiet stillness as everyone focused on their tasks.
peaceful means motionless and calm. e.g. The gentle sound of the waves lapping against the shore filled her with calm. & Sitting under the shade of the old tree, he felt completely at ease.

joy means a feeling of extreme happiness or cheerfulness, especially related to the acquisition or expectation of something good. e.g. When she received the good news, a bright smile spread across her face. & At the celebration, laughter filled the room, creating a vibrant atmosphere.

sadness means emotionally negative and feeling sorrow. e.g. He stared out the window, his heart heavy with a lingering sense of loss. & As she walked through the empty hall, a wave of nostalgia washed over her.

scared means feeling afraid and frightened. e.g. A cold sweat broke out on his forehead as he heard footsteps behind him in the dark. & She held her breath, feeling a knot tighten in her stomach during the thunderstorm.
mad means feeling angry and annoyed. e.g. He slammed the door shut, frustration boiling beneath the surface. & Her eyes flashed with irritation as she listened to the unfair remarks.

powerful means having, or capable of exerting, power or influence. e.g. Standing at the edge of the cliff, she felt an overwhelming sense of strength and determination. & The speaker's voice resonated through the hall, commanding everyone’s attention.
